title: OpenBook fixture_change
description: A diff to a reference_fixture, JSON Merge Patch semantics: the fixture id plus only the fields that changed (a moved start time, a state flip, a lineup change). Fields absent are unchanged; null removes.

operation.description: OsmChange-style. A delete carries no changes.

changes.description: A JSON Merge Patch against the reference_fixture document (any subset of its fields).
